Question: In the UNESCO UIS SDG 4 Education Indicators table for the indicator 'Completion rate, upper secondary education, both sexes (modelled data) (%)', what value is listed for Syrian Arab Republic (SYR) in 2023?

A. 36.04000091552734%
B. 37.97000122070313%

Source citation: UNESCO UIS SDG 4 Education Indicators: Completion rate, upper secondary education, both sexes (modelled data) (%) (https://data.unesco.org/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/uis001/records?where=indicator_id+%3D+%22CR.MOD.3%22+and+year+%3D+date%272023-01-01%27&order_by=country_id&limit=100&offset=100)

Supplied draft answer: B
